summary.text: Wife of godlike Oileus whose kin Medon slew, driving the bastard son to dwell in Phylace far from Locrian land — named only as the stepmother whose family tie drew the exile.

story.text: Medon, bastard son of Oileus and brother of Ajax, dwelt in Phylace far from his native land, for that he had slain a man of the kin of his stepmother Eriopis that Oileus had to wife.
